findings.title: Disabled accounts can bypass the database suspension boundary
findings.scope: Existing backend defect; present at committed baseline and in current staging schema.
findings.evidence: Ordinary authenticated SQL in disposable PostgreSQL read one own progress row while disabled, then updated one own profiles row to clear deleted_at. Staging read-only inspection confirms UPDATE privilege on profiles.deleted_at, the self-update policy, only the timestamp trigger, and has_role without a disabled-profile predicate. No live user token was used.
findings.impact: An account holding a valid Supabase JWT can continue ordinary database access and undo its application suspension through the public API. The application’s disabled-account check can then accept the re-enabled profile.
findings.remediation: Version-controlled migration: remove table-wide self UPDATE, allow only intended editable profile columns, protect deleted_at and other authority fields, and enforce the documented disabled-account rule in ordinary-user RLS/authorization helpers. Keep the audited manager RPC as the authorized status-changing path.
findings.retest: With approved synthetic A/B sessions: active A positive control; disable A through authorized manager; A GET/PATCH and relevant RPCs must be denied without changing the flag; authorized manager restores only the audit-created account. Verify valid pre-disable JWT, fresh login and re-enabled positive control.

findings.title: New bookmarks cannot target the published pilot lesson in staging
findings.evidence: Fresh privileged read-only metadata finds no lessons row for basic-fluid-pressure, hydraulic-cylinder-force or bernoulli-flow-lab. The pilot lesson exists as governance item ee1c9dd7-83a1-4811-9fce-3cb517186a9f, current/published governance version 4. The new repository requires lessons.id for both isSaved and setSaved. A no-row adapter probe rejects before any bookmark write.
findings.impact: On a deployment of this source against current staging, the only public lesson cannot be read/saved through this bookmark adapter. Existing fixture tests succeed because the local store accepts a slug directly.
findings.remediation: Choose one canonical lesson identity compatible with the reviewed governance-backed pilot. Either bridge a valid governed relational lesson row or migrate bookmark references to the stable governed content ID. Use a migration if the schema changes; preserve RLS and existing rows. Do not create a merely labelled published row to bypass review evidence.
findings.retest: Approved synthetic staging bookmark journey: save, verify exact row/owner/lesson mapping, fresh browser, signout/in, B read/update/delete denials with A positive control, duplicate save, remove only audit-created bookmark. Include withdrawal behavior.

findings.title: Historical attempt review is paired with the current assessment
findings.scope: Existing assessment read path, not introduced by the added lessonSlug field.
findings.evidence: Audit fixture inserted an owned completed contentVersion 1 attempt. loadCompletedAssessmentReview returned that attempt with summary.contentVersion 2; loadAssessmentAttemptPage likewise returned current content. Dashboard links already apply a stricter version check, but direct URLs omit it. The SQL submission path separately rejects mismatched versions.
findings.impact: Direct historical review can combine an old score with current questions/feedback and potentially disclose current graded feedback based on an earlier-version completion. Actual historical staging attempts were not read.
findings.remediation: Bind delivery and review to the persisted attempt version/hash. Either load the exact archived reviewed assessment or return an honest unavailable state when it differs from the installed catalogue; do not substitute current feedback.
findings.retest: Positive current-version owned review; owned prior-version in-progress and completed direct URLs; later-version-only DB row; another owner; no current answers returned for an old completion.

findings.title: Authentication and data adapters disagree in mixed local/Supabase configuration
findings.scope: Existing configuration boundary; correctly labelled staging/production rejects local auth.
findings.evidence: With test/local/E2E=true, a configured Supabase URL/key and a non-loopback APP_BASE_URL, the explicit local safety validator rejected the environment. getAuthProvider nevertheless selected Supabase before calling that validator; dashboard data then came from fixture memory without a network request. No actual configured environment was changed.
findings.impact: A mislabelled deployment/development process can authenticate real identities but silently store/show demonstration data. The bookmark selector can fail while other stores still operate locally. This is not a client-controlled mode switch.
findings.remediation: Centralize one validated backend-mode decision. Reject mixed fixture/live configuration and non-loopback test mode before any provider or repository is selected.
findings.retest: Complete mode matrix with configured/missing keys, loopback/non-loopback base URL and development/test/staging/production; all features must select the same mode or fail closed.

findings.title: The Supabase author workspace has no draft loading/editing journey
findings.scope: Existing incomplete feature; preserved by frontend redesign.
findings.evidence: In Supabase mode the loader always returns items=[] and dataSource=unavailable. The rendered workspace lists authoring capabilities but does not surface that source state as an unavailable error. Local fixtures populate the view.
findings.impact: An author can see an empty workspace even when governed drafts exist, and the capability copy overstates the available interface. Repository previews and reviewer database paths are separate.
findings.remediation: Wire an ownership-scoped live draft loader and the intended author operations, or explicitly label this workspace and listed operations as unavailable/deferred until implemented.
findings.retest: Synthetic author with an owned draft positive control, author without drafts, another author’s scope, database outage and unavailable UI. No actual content approval is needed.

findings.title: Privileged simulation adapter does not enforce exact database publication evidence
findings.scope: Existing dormant integration gap; current public standalone simulation catalogue is empty.
findings.evidence: The server’s service-role selectors filter slug and two status labels, without has_current_engineering_publication or a catalogue/database version comparison. Service role bypasses the restrictive RLS predicate. Current catalogue gates and staging internal/Source required status block the existing simulation; no current student launch bypass was demonstrated.
findings.impact: When simulations become eligible in repository content, this adapter could accept stale or unsupported database publication labels and bind server runtime to a different DB version.
findings.remediation: Before enabling a simulation, require independent exact-version simulation review/publication evidence in its server path and trusted completion transaction, with matching repository/runtime identity.
findings.retest: Valid simulation positive control plus missing approval/assignment, later rejection, archived parent, current/version mismatch, service-role path and mid-attempt withdrawal. Keep all fixtures isolated.

findings.title: Library counts and save/progress states use a capped dashboard window
findings.scope: New My Learning projection reuses existing summary queries.
findings.evidence: Summary limits are 25 lesson-progress rows and 10 saved rows. The library treats absent entries as Available/unsaved and has no pagination to retrieve older records. Only the saved filter displays a recent-items notice. A capped-progress probe returns Available despite a limited section. Current public catalogue contains only one lesson, limiting present-day impact.
findings.impact: As content grows, older completions/bookmarks can disappear from counts and controls even though durable records remain.
findings.remediation: Use paginated library-specific queries or fetch complete state for the displayed public lesson IDs; distinguish unknown/truncated state and expose totals honestly.
findings.retest: More than 25 progress and 10 saved records, including older eligible entries; all filters, counts, card state and pagination.

findings.title: Unknown account-status operation is interpreted as enable
findings.evidence: disabled is computed as operation === disable; the validator never checks an enable/disable enum. A valid manager form with any other operation reaches p_disabled=false. This is static evidence; no live account action was invoked.
findings.impact: Malformed authorized requests can enable an account instead of being rejected. It does not grant management rights to students.
findings.remediation: Reject missing/unknown operation before computing the boolean or calling the RPC.
findings.retest: Manager requests with enable/disable positive controls and missing/unknown values; non-manager rejection; unchanged target on validation failure.

findings.title: Withdrawn bookmark removal is blocked by the same eligibility lookup as saving
findings.evidence: Both remove and save require a currently public static lesson and a visible published lessons row. The removal probe with no visible lesson rejects before DELETE. Saved-item projections do filter protected content.
findings.impact: A user cannot remove an existing bookmark once its content is withdrawn; no protected lesson content leak was observed.
findings.remediation: Allow deletion by an authenticated owner’s existing bookmark identifier/stable lesson reference without requiring content delivery eligibility. Keep read/title delivery gated.
findings.retest: Save eligible fixture, withdraw its content in isolated/authorized infrastructure, verify no metadata leak and successful owner-only removal.

findings.title: Account switching leaves the previous user’s private library in another tab
findings.scope: Confirmed on the redesigned My Learning page in a shared local browser context.
findings.evidence: A saved a bookmark in My Learning. A second tab signed out and registered synthetic B in the same browser context. After returning focus, the original tab’s shell showed B while its protected page still displayed A’s identity and saved bookmark. A fresh B page correctly showed no bookmarks. Only boolean results were retained.
findings.impact: A shared browser can display the previous account’s private data after its session changes. Backend ownership still blocks fresh unauthorized reads; this is stale client-rendered data, not a cross-owner database query.
findings.remediation: Invalidate or clear every private page when the authenticated identity changes or logout occurs, including cross-tab changes. Refresh/replace the server-rendered library before displaying the newly resolved identity; use a consistent account-change signal rather than updating only the header.
findings.retest: Two same-context tabs: A to B and A to signed-out, My Learning/dashboard/results and other private routes, focus/visibility/back navigation, delayed or failed account checks. Confirm no mixed identity/private body and retain A/B backend positive controls.

checks.sanitized_evidence: Complete mode matrix with configured/missing keys, loopback/non-loopback base URL and development/test/staging/production; all features must select the same mode or fail closed.

checks.requirement: The Supabase author workspace has no draft loading/editing journey
checks.feature_or_route: Existing incomplete feature; preserved by frontend redesign.
checks.evidence_kind: static + local reproduction and/or live catalog as stated
checks.expected: Wire an ownership-scoped live draft loader and the intended author operations, or explicitly label this workspace and listed operations as unavailable/deferred until implemented.
checks.observed: In Supabase mode the loader always returns items=[] and dataSource=unavailable. The rendered workspace lists authoring capabilities but does not surface that source state as an unavailable error. Local fixtures populate the view.
checks.sanitized_evidence: Synthetic author with an owned draft positive control, author without drafts, another author’s scope, database outage and unavailable UI. No actual content approval is needed.

checks.requirement: Privileged simulation adapter does not enforce exact database publication evidence
checks.feature_or_route: Existing dormant integration gap; current public standalone simulation catalogue is empty.
checks.evidence_kind: static + local reproduction and/or live catalog as stated
checks.expected: Before enabling a simulation, require independent exact-version simulation review/publication evidence in its server path and trusted completion transaction, with matching repository/runtime identity.
checks.observed: The server’s service-role selectors filter slug and two status labels, without has_current_engineering_publication or a catalogue/database version comparison. Service role bypasses the restrictive RLS predicate. Current catalogue gates and staging internal/Source required status block the existing simulation; no current student launch bypass was demonstrated.
checks.sanitized_evidence: Valid simulation positive control plus missing approval/assignment, later rejection, archived parent, current/version mismatch, service-role path and mid-attempt withdrawal. Keep all fixtures isolated.

checks.requirement: Library counts and save/progress states use a capped dashboard window
checks.feature_or_route: New My Learning projection reuses existing summary queries.
checks.evidence_kind: static + local reproduction and/or live catalog as stated
checks.expected: Use paginated library-specific queries or fetch complete state for the displayed public lesson IDs; distinguish unknown/truncated state and expose totals honestly.
checks.observed: Summary limits are 25 lesson-progress rows and 10 saved rows. The library treats absent entries as Available/unsaved and has no pagination to retrieve older records. Only the saved filter displays a recent-items notice. A capped-progress probe returns Available despite a limited section. Current public catalogue contains only one lesson, limiting present-day impact.
checks.sanitized_evidence: More than 25 progress and 10 saved records, including older eligible entries; all filters, counts, card state and pagination.

checks.requirement: Unknown account-status operation is interpreted as enable
checks.evidence_kind: static + local reproduction and/or live catalog as stated
checks.expected: Reject missing/unknown operation before computing the boolean or calling the RPC.
checks.observed: disabled is computed as operation === disable; the validator never checks an enable/disable enum. A valid manager form with any other operation reaches p_disabled=false. This is static evidence; no live account action was invoked.
checks.sanitized_evidence: Manager requests with enable/disable positive controls and missing/unknown values; non-manager rejection; unchanged target on validation failure.

checks.requirement: Withdrawn bookmark removal is blocked by the same eligibility lookup as saving
checks.evidence_kind: static + local reproduction and/or live catalog as stated
checks.expected: Allow deletion by an authenticated owner’s existing bookmark identifier/stable lesson reference without requiring content delivery eligibility. Keep read/title delivery gated.
checks.observed: Both remove and save require a currently public static lesson and a visible published lessons row. The removal probe with no visible lesson rejects before DELETE. Saved-item projections do filter protected content.
checks.sanitized_evidence: Save eligible fixture, withdraw its content in isolated/authorized infrastructure, verify no metadata leak and successful owner-only removal.

checks.requirement: Account switching leaves the previous user’s private library in another tab
checks.feature_or_route: Confirmed on the redesigned My Learning page in a shared local browser context.
checks.evidence_kind: static + local reproduction and/or live catalog as stated
checks.expected: Invalidate or clear every private page when the authenticated identity changes or logout occurs, including cross-tab changes. Refresh/replace the server-rendered library before displaying the newly resolved identity; use a consistent account-change signal rather than updating only the header.
checks.observed: A saved a bookmark in My Learning. A second tab signed out and registered synthetic B in the same browser context. After returning focus, the original tab’s shell showed B while its protected page still displayed A’s identity and saved bookmark. A fresh B page correctly showed no bookmarks. Only boolean results were retained.
checks.sanitized_evidence: Two same-context tabs: A to B and A to signed-out, My Learning/dashboard/results and other private routes, focus/visibility/back navigation, delayed or failed account checks. Confirm no mixed identity/private body and retain A/B backend positive controls.
